Restaurants and dining in Bilene

After the water, time to eat

A day on the water deserves a great evening. In Bilene, good food is never far away — from the Palmeiras terrace with your feet in the sand, to the local tables we are happy to share with you.

The Palmeiras restaurant

Right on site, with your feet in the sand, the Palmeiras restaurant and beach bar will be your go-to from aperitif to dinner. Over a "2M" — the unmissable local beer — you can watch the last riders finish their session from your sunbed.

Breakfast is served every morning, generous and very Mozambican. You may find chips on the menu — that is the local take on a full breakfast, and if you would rather go without, just ask!

The BKC Team Barbecue

Once a week, we organise a team barbecue. Fresh produce, good company, and the sunset over the lagoon as a backdrop — the perfect opportunity to share a drink with fellow riders, swap stories from the day's best sessions and enjoy an evening the way we like them.

Our restaurant outings

Every other evening, we invite you to join us at our favourite spots in Bilene. A handful of typical local restaurants run by locals, where the food is fresh, simple and full of flavour. No tourist guide, no menu in four languages — just good tables we eat at ourselves and are happy to share with you.

Mail : contact@bilenekite.com
